summary: Lincoln County, MT lookout near Yaak: a 1921 30-foot pole tower and log cabin, abandoned. The site listing says the cabin is ruins; the FFLA list says gone.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with a log cabin
facts.status_note: The site listing says the 1921 log cabin is still there, in ruins. The FFLA Montana list gives the status as gone.

events.note: 30-foot pole tower and log cabin, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: 1921 30-foot pole tower and log cabin; cabin still there as ruins; abandoned
evidence.quote: 1921: 30' pole tower, log cabin (still there, ruins). Abandoned.

evidence.supports: first firelookout.com listing is titled Canuck Mountain
second page repeats the same details under the Canuck Peak name
evidence.quote: CANUCK PEAK LOOKOUT 1921: 30' pole tower, log cabin (still there, ruins). Abandoned.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists status gone for Canuck Peak

corrections.why: The site listing says the 1921 log cabin is still there as ruins, while the FFLA list says gone. Check on the ground before changing; no source says the tower itself is standing.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one site listing (firelookout.com, two pages with identical text) gives the 1921 date, abandoned status and cabin ruins. The first listing is titled Canuck Mountain; the second is titled Canuck Peak, and the story now says so. The FFLA list says gone. The parenthetical '(still there, ruins)' follows both the pole tower and the cabin; the story reads it as the cabin, the natural reading. If it applies to the tower, the FFLA 'Tower Gone' entry conflicts with the listing directly. The Forest Lookouts land description (37N-34W-34) was not checked against the coordinates. No staffing, fire, access or photo information was found; one search and two page reads for this lookout. Verification quote count is from the first run (8); one quote was added in this pass and is also found.
